description: Main FastAPI application setup and route definitions for a personal journal REST API. Handles CRUD operations for journal entries, static file serving, database initialization, and upload handling.

methods.name: str _save_upload(file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Saves uploaded image files securely to the static uploads directory, returning the URL path.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple message to verify service availability.

methods.name: list_journal_entries()
methods.description: Retrieves all journal entries, ordered by most recent updates.

methods.name: get_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to fetch", ge=1) )
methods.description: Fetches a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: create_journal_entry( title: str = Form(..., description="Title for the journal entry (1..200 chars)"), content: str = Form(..., description="Content/body for the entry (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file"), )
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry, optionally with an uploaded image.

methods.name: update_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to update", ge=1), title: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated title (1..200 chars)"), content: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated content (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file to replace existing"), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form(False, description="Set true to remove existing image"), )
methods.description: Updates an existing journal entry's title, content, and/or image.

methods.name: delete_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to delete", ge=1) )
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by its ID.

ctags.signature: ( title: str = Form(..., description="Title for the journal entry (1..200 chars)"), content: str = Form(..., description="Content/body for the entry (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file"), )

ctags.signature: ( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to delete", ge=1) )
